name: SMARTWORKS COWORKING SP L
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited owns, operates, and leases co-working spaces in India. The company operates and maintains serviced office spaces, meeting and training rooms, virtual offices, and other ancillary services. It also provides maintenance and house-keeping services to commercial properties and business houses; and software booking application for meeting room management and booking, visitor management system, and attendance management system. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
